Root Cause: The gateway pods mount the gateway-limits ConfigMap using subPath: "limits.yaml", which prevents ConfigMap updates. Kubernetes documentation states that containers using ConfigMap with subPath will not receive updates.

Evidence: Pod logs show the limits watcher consistently reporting "unchanged (sha256=9c1e4b07)" at 09:12:30, 10:05:30, and 11:29:30 - long after the 09:10 limit increase. The gateway still reads limit_rps=100 for acme-logistics.

Fix: Remove the subPath from the limits volume mount. Mount the entire ConfigMap directory instead. ConfigMap updates are propagated automatically (within ~2 minutes) when not using subPath [cite: concepts/storage/volumes#configmap-2].
